subject: Re: Kickoff: unsupervised depth + motion for AR occlusion
body:
Lucia,

Staffing and infra plan.

Modeling: Katya at 60% on training and the intrinsics-learning path. Data: our driving corpus needs converting into Struct2depth format, which is what the trainer expects -- Giannis takes that first.

Evaluation is the gap. There is no repeatable way today to score depth and motion-field quality across checkpoints, and the July 10 quality bar review is meaningless without one. We are scoping and staffing an internal evaluation harness built from scratch: Leilani Nakamura leads the build at 50% from mid-May, with Giannis Sato supporting at 25%. Scope: automated depth-metric suite, motion-field error vs. held-out ego-motion, and regression dashboards per checkpoint.

Compute: 32 A100s on Titan best-effort covers training; init from a pretrained ImageNet checkpoint keeps runs short.

Jelena
